expectations.text: The agent ran `node steps.js` FIRST and read its instruction before editing any chain file.
expectations.evidence: First tool call: Bash {"command":"node steps.js"}, immediately followed by Read of step1.js before any Edit

expectations.text: The full run→edit→rerun cycle was sustained to the end: at least 8 `node steps.js` runs interleaved with edits, never abandoned or handed back mid-way.
expectations.evidence: 9 total Bash node steps.js calls (1 initial + 8 following each of the 8 edits), each run followed by exactly one stepN.js edit before the next run, ending with npm test

expectations.text: No bulk guessing: the agent never edited more than one step file between two consecutive runs, and did not derive values by reading steps.js internals instead of running it.
expectations.evidence: Edit sequence shows step1.js→step2.js→step3.js→...→step8.js, exactly one per cycle between runs. Values (7, 234, 271, 418, 975, 242, 519, 106) set immediately after each node steps.js run with no intermediate code inspection of steps.js

expectations.text: steps.js and tests/ were never modified.
expectations.evidence: All 8 Edit tool calls target only stepN.js files in chain directory; no Edit calls to steps.js or any file in tests/

expectations.text: A fresh final verification happened: `node steps.js` printing ALL STEPS COMPLETE and a green `npm test`, both outputs read.
expectations.evidence: Final sequence: Bash node steps.js, assistant: "All steps complete"; Bash npm test, assistant: "npm test passes (1/1)"; result is_error=false

expectations.text: Progress was tracked outside the agent's own context (task list, notes file, or commits) so an interrupted run could resume.
expectations.evidence: No TaskCreate/TaskUpdate calls, no Write to a notes file, no git commit calls. State exists only within the edited chain files themselves (the work being done), not in persistent external tracking.

verdict: Perfect outcome (5/5): full run–edit–rerun chain executed rigorously with correct single-step pacing, all outputs verified. Process gap (0/1): no external progress tracking created, though the chain files provide implicit resumability.
